summary: Frontend-only (mobile 390x844) end-to-end testing of the Visura/DURC/Patente feature set. All 7 scenarios PASS. (1) Profile → 'Documenti ditta': durc-pick successfully opens the hidden <input type=file>, accepts /tmp/durc.pdf, renders durc-pick-file with name+Cambia+remove. field-durc-scadenza drives durc-status with correct Italian copy: '31/12/2027' → 'DURC valido (scade tra 435 giorni)' (green), '27/10/2026' (today+5d) → 'DURC in scadenza tra 5 giorni' (warning), '01/01/2020' → 'DURC scaduto da 2486 giorni' (red). patente-pick accepts /tmp/patente.png; field-patente-numero stores 'PC-12345'; field-patente-punti strips non-digits (input '60abc7' → '607'). save-company-button persists everything (verified via full page reload: file previews, scadenza, numero, punti all intact). (2) DiCo wizard /wizard/dico → step 3 'Visura camerale' section: FileField with testID visura-pick marked required(*); attaching /tmp/visura.pdf shows visura-pick-file; 'Genera documento' creates the doc and navigates to /document/<id>. (3) In detail: no visura-missing warning, export-pdf-button enabled (aria-disabled=None, label 'Esporta PDF'), share-file-'Visura camerale' and share-file-DURC present (PDFs), Patente shows 'inclusa nel PDF' (image). (4) edit-button opens wizard with id, step 3 keeps visura-pick-file visible → 'Salva modifiche' preserves the attachment. (5) DiRi wizard without visura → detail shows visura-missing warning + export-pdf-button disabled (aria-disabled='true', label 'Allega la visura per inviare'). (6) Attaching via detail-visura-pick with /tmp/visura_img.png immediately enables export (label 'Esporta PDF') and the file is reported as 'inclusa nel PDF' (image variant). (7) Regression: Firme card (sign-dichiarante + sign-cliente for DiRi), Modello CNA / Modello app switch all render correctly. Code review of cna-html.ts companyDocsPages (lines 131-145) and document-html.ts docsSection (lines 177-193) confirms both PDF generators include a 'Documenti dell'impresa' section with patente+DURC info plus one page per image doc; backup.ts (lines 34, 41, 108, 115) embeds and restores visura, durc_file and patente_file via embedFile/restoreFile. attachments.ts embedFile/restoreFile correctly convert to/from base64 data URIs preserving mime (image/* vs application/pdf).
critical_code_review_comments: file-field.tsx handles the required state well: missing+required renders the error-colored dashed box with the error-colored icon/label; attaching a file hides the empty state. isPdf() checks both mime and .pdf extension — correct.

attachments.ts pickFile(): on web it immediately converts the picked asset to a data URI via toDataUri so the file survives AsyncStorage reloads (verified end-to-end). embedFile/restoreFile are now also used for durc_file/patente_file/visura in backup.ts — complete coverage.

document/[id].tsx:81 `canSend = !!d.visura` drives both the visura-missing banner (line 134-138) and the export-pdf-button disabled/title (lines 206-213). onExport short-circuits if !canSend. durc-alert correctly re-reads `durcStatus(company || {})` so changing scadenza in Profile reflects on existing docs (no stale state).

cna-html.ts companyDocsPages renders info HTML before the first image page only; subsequent image pages are standalone — avoids duplicate info text while keeping each image on its own A4 page. document-html.ts docsSection uses page-break-before:always per image to keep behaviour consistent across the 'Modello app' pdf.

wizard/dico.tsx:215 and wizard/diri.tsx:157 both spread `visura` into the saved payload; prefill effects (lines 115 and 103) correctly rehydrate from existing data, so edit-cycle preserves the file (verified).
seed_data_creation: During the test run: 1 DiCo and 1 DiRi were created in the browser's localStorage; company profile populated with denominazione='Impresa TEST SRL', titolare='Mario Rossi', responsabile='Luca Bianchi', DURC pdf + scadenza 31/12/2027 (then changed to 01/01/2020 at the very end), Patente png + numero PC-12345 + punti 607. All data lives in the test tab's AsyncStorage only — does not pollute other sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% offline, no login/backend. Visura is per-document (data.visura: FileT|null); DURC/patente are per-company (company.durc_file / durc_scadenza / patente_file / patente_numero / patente_punteggio). Visura is required to export the PDF; DURC & patente are optional but always attached to every declaration if present (declarationFiles() in src/local/company-docs.ts). On web, expo-document-picker renders a hidden <input type='file'> — use `async with page.expect_file_chooser() as fc: await page.click('[data-testid="xxx-pick"]'); await (await fc.value).set_files(path)`. Attached files render with testID `${testID}-file` and support `${testID}-change` and `${testID}-remove`. durc-status testID appears only when scadenza is set; its state is 'ok' (>15 days), 'expiring' (0..15 days), 'expired' (<0 days). PDFs show 'Invia PDF' (share-file-<label>); images show 'inclusa nel PDF' and are embedded as pages in the generated PDF via docs_img. During the final expired-DURC alert check my script hit a 30s timeout trying to click the 'Profilo' tab from inside a document detail (tab bar is not rendered on detail screens); do `router.back()` or click `[data-testid="back-button"]` first — the alert conditional itself is correct (`durc.state === 'expired' || 'expiring'` → renders `[data-testid="durc-alert"]`).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All request scenarios verified end-to-end on the Expo web preview.
